{{Quote|The Wookiees in this area ride these maru to get around without being detected by the Separatists. They've mounted dual bowcasters and a seismic charge emitter onto the harness. Should take care of most predators in the forest.|Bera Kazan|<ref name="TCW" />}}
The '''seismic pulse emitter''',<ref name="Unknown" /> also known as the '''seismic charge emitter''' was a device used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] inhabitants of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="TCW" /> following its [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Wookiees used the moon's native [[Maru/Legends|maru]] as war mounts, equipping them with harnesses fitted with two [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] and a seismic pulse emitter.<ref name="Unknown" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when Alaris Prime was [[Battle on Alaris|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bera Kazan]] allied with the Wookiees, who had been using the maru to evade the Separatists. Skywalker and Kazan rode a maru each to infiltrate a [[Separatist outpost (Alaris Prime)|Separatist outpost]], using their bowcasters and seismic charge emitters to destroy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Gnasp/Legends|gnasps]] they encountered on their path. Along with several Wookiees they also used maru and seismic charge emitters to defend a [[Wookiee village (Alaris Prime)|Wookiee village]] from a Separatist offensive.<ref name="TCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seismic charge emitters first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']].<ref name="TCW" />
